This build includes enemy variants! You can see the enemy variants at level 16 and beyond.
A lot of small tweaks have been made to improve performance.
The scoring system and difficulty curve have been balanced out a bit too.
-Made audio visualization a bit more intense.
-Reduced number of score multiplier bonuses.

This is a small update.
-Menus fade in and out a bit more nicely (I'll be continuing with this).
-Right trigger can now be used to fire the blaster.
-Backgrounds have different geometry.
-A graphics options menu was added to the game.
-Major Feature: Added chip speech tracks for Lady Parsec. She says things when you pickup items or your ship gets damaged.

-Added a particle effect for picking up items.
-New particle systems for bullets, enemy explosions, collisions, etc,!!!
-Bullets are bigger so it will be easier to hit enemies now.
-Item hit boxes are larger so that they are easier to collect now.
-A lot of general maintenance and performance fixes.
-The game should look and feel a bit better to play now.
-Trying new settings for performance improvements.
-Remove some of the static barriers to make the game a bit easier.
Fixed a minor bug where the bloom intensity was becoming excessive.
This patch includes
-New lower polygon models. This will make the game run more smoothly.
-Updated game feel for barrel rolls and special abilities.

notes.title: Three major parts to this update

items.text: 1) All of the blasters and abilities have been modified to improve performance.
2) Blasters will now regress if you take damage.
3) A bunch of graphical performance improvements. These don't really affect quality, but the game runs more smoothly on lower end hardware.
This is probably the most difficult version of the game released to date. Please bare with me. I'll make it a bit easier in the future.
Been working on making the game feel better.
-Buttons and UI rumble, cause screen shake and flash a bit.

Will continue working on making the game juicier and better feeling.

items.text: Another Attempt at fixing the Linux build
This build rolls out a brand new UI throughout the game.
This build also fixes many bugs related to the scoring system as well as the game ending.
This update strips out some of the backgrounds for performance reasons (they'll be back eventually).
This will fix the bugs that came up related to the in-game UIs.
Oops I broke the Linux build. This should fix it.
-Reduced some poly counts.
-Reduced physics collider precision.
-Reduced some graphics settings.
Will be redoing a bunch of UI elements next.
-Reduced poly count on some more models.
-Simplified some physics colliders.
-Eliminated update methods for enemies waiting to be recycled.
Did a bunch of optimizations for CPU/GPU performance.
-Upgraded ship control. Diagonal ship movement is no longer faster than horizontal/vertical movement.
-Upgraded camera scripts to prevent ship from going off screen or being hidden behind the HUD.
More performance upgrades.
Collision particle systems simplified and some performance related code fixes.
LZ4HC compression used on both Windows and Linux builds.
This patch reduces the amount of particle systems and includes some other minor performance improvements to the code base.
The Linux build now uses LZ4HC compression which may result in performance improvements as well.
This will make the gameplay experience better for older hardware.
-SAM's speech causes post-processing effects.
-Fixed grid bug at level end.
-Fixed shield regen bug at level end.
-Fixed rendering issues with player's health and shield bar.
-Added more SAM voice clips (story is somewhat more complete)
-Reduced length of some of the background audio tracks. Most of the tracks are less than 3 minutes and 30 seconds.
-Fixed bug on high score table.
-Made improvement to high score screen (it shows your score now).
-Changed fire rate of basic weapon.
Barrel rolls have been mapped to the Z and C keys.
This patch adds several new abilities and new barrel rolls.
Have fun!
Made a whole bunch of updates to the UI. There's particle backgrounds and different looking buttons. More to come eventually...
That didn't work.
Hopefully this one does it.
I'll be testing compatibility of both Windows and Linux when this is over and done with.
-Visual enhancements to the cyber tunnel (each level has a unique pattern now).
-Added cyber tunnel enhancements to credits screen.
-Level end screen now goes through a multiplier countdown.
This patch introduces the "Cyber Tunnel"! This represents a major graphical overhaul for the game.
Fixed annoying sound at the beginning of each level.
Eliminated some annoying collision sounds at the end of each level.
1) New HUD layout.
2) 8 new weapons.
3) 9 new collectible items.
4) Bugfixes galore!
-A new item has been added to the game. It is a basically a random item. It only shows up later in the game or during one SAM's special phrases.
-Some adjustments were made to how the camera follows the player. This is still a work in progress.
-SAM speaks in colors now. Enemies spawn when he speaks.
-Fixed a bunch of bugs.
-Still have tons of work to do.
-Have fun!
Added particle effects from the EPIC Toon FX unity asset into the project.

Integration of the new particle effects is only partially completed. A lot of the explosions and other particle effects will probably look very similar. Its going to take a while to get everything dialed in just right.
There are still tons of items on the "to-do" list for this project. Thanks for your patience.
1) Added a crash sequence when the player runs out of health.
2) Fixed some minor bugs related to the end of the level menu.
3) Fixed minor bug related to camera not centering at the beginning of each level.

Implemented Cinemachine. This changes the way the camera follows the player in game. It will also allow for some interesting "cinematic" opportunities going forward.: -New Level End Sequence. The player flies into a portal and warps to the next level.
There were some issues with the game crashing between menus and levels. This should improve the issue.
Some of the enemies shown in the main menu were showing up in the game. This is fixed now too.
1) New main menu screen
2) Fixed bugs related to camera shake and boost sound when game was paused.
Patch Notes - January 10, 2020
-Monochrome option
-New pause menu
-More SAM lines
-Bugfixes related to main menu, pause menu and post processing effects
Added volume adjustment sliders to the options menu.
1) Fixed issue with enemy scores showing up at inappropriate times.
2) Created a custom brightness profile for each level.
3) UFO shooting issues are fixed. These enemies will be far more dangerous now.
4) Levels 31 and 32 are now working.
5) Fixed issue with the missile's trail. This looks much cleaner now.
1) Changed all music to .xm and .mod format. Program size and loading times are significantly better because of this.
2) Missiles do area of effect damage.
3) Fixed issues related to bullets/missiles colliding with items.
4) Fixed some bugs related to the health and shield bars. Fixes will be ongoing.
5) Fixed some issues related to SAM talking during game over screen and other inappropriate times. Fixes will be ongoing for this issue.
6) Bullets now become transparent when they are too close to the camera. This will help with screen cluttering.
7) Added music to the main menu.
8) Added barrel roll controls for the keyboard.
9) Removed deprecated files related to aimers from the build.
10) Boosting at the end of the level would make the player's ship glow in the next level. This issue was fixed.
11) Made the material for the biohazard crates less bright.
12) Fixed issue related to purple bomb dropping enemies spawning into the game backwards.
13) Fixed issue with executing a barrel roll at the end of the level causing an issue in the new level.
14) The bullet trail used to go through the player's spaceship. This issue is fixed.
15) Overall file size is reduced to ~115 MB.
Barrel roll is now working by double tapping either of the should buttons on your controller!!!
Made hit box for items larger. This means that they are slightly easier to collect.
Made hit box for the cube enemy bigger. This means that it is slight easier to shoot, but also slightly easier to crash into.
Note: Support for keyboard barrel rolls is current unavailable. This issue will be resolved in the near future.
-Added full restore health and full restore shield items.
1) Eliminated dither mode.
2) Made multiple changes to the game's graphics.
3) Increased the horizontal and vertical movement speed of the player's ship.
4) Removed particle effects when the walls are shot or crashed into.
1) From level 11 onwards there is a new item that can be found. It changes the character's default attack to shoot either 3 or 5 projectiles. If the player takes damage the new weapon is disabled.
2) The way the camera moves has been changed. I'm not thrilled with how it turned out. Its probably a step in the right direction, but I'll continue trying to improve this.
1) I'll continue putting in additional items and power-ups in order to make the game more fair and balanced.

2) Game performance may be negatively impacted by the new weapon power-ups on certain systems. Having multiple projectiles and particle systems on the screen at once can be intensive on certain systems. I'll be disabling some of the particle effects and changing some graphics settings to ensure a buttery smooth 60fps on most systems.
The size of the playfield has been doubled. The game looks and plays a lot differently now. Some of the later levels are definitely a bit overwhelming, but with time things will be balanced properly.
-Did a lot of work on rebalancing SAM's voice, the music and sound effects. Its not perfect, but a lot better.
-Bugfix: Pausing the game will now stop SAM's voice.
-Bugfix: Boosting at level end will not make the player invincible or continue the boost indefinitely.
1) Enabled camera shake on player damage.
2) Fixed issue with items disappearing from the game.
3) Reduced collision forces between bullets and enemies. Some of these collisions were a little over the top.

notes.title: The following bugs have been fixed

items.text: 1) Boost at level end would cause joystick to rumble continuously.
2) Crashing the spaceship at level end would cause the joystick to rumble continuously.
3) Joystick rumble is stopped as soon as the pause button is pressed.
4) Enemies were sometimes showing up as invisible.
5) A few bugs related to how the missiles were counted have been fixed.
6) Certain particle systems were not being removed from memory.
7) Sliding walls sometimes had arrows pointing in the wrong direction.
Fixed issue related to enemies glowing.
1) Completely new procedural generation engine
2) Added two new instructions screens
3) Added two new items: score bonus and score multiplier
4) Item visual effects updated
5) Levels 1-30 are now accessible
6) Removed some redundant files. Program size is ~200 MB
7) Updated warning screen
8) Updated credits screen
Updates will become more regular for the foreseeable future (hopefully every day or two).

Doing a massive overhaul on the way levels are generated in the game. This will make it easier to add more content to the game. Expect to see a major update to the product in about two weeks. Two new items will be included with the next update. These will be a score bonus item and a score multiplier bonus item.
-Added chiptune music from Mr. Gamer.
-Added more details to the credits screen.
-Modified introduction screens for better resolution compatibility.
November 9, 2020 --- Update Log
1) Implemented level select screen.
2) Enabled scoreboard.
3) Anti-seizure mode is disabled by default.
4) Dither mode is disabled by default.
-Randomized locations of items.
-"Enter" button now works in menus for keyboard users.
-Rudimentary level completed screen implemented.
-Fixed bug that caused player to boost when leaving pause menu.
-Included seizure warning.
-Implemented anti-seizure mode menu option.
